headline: Dr Samia urges EAC bloc to advance vehicle-making industry to reduce imports of  second-hand vehicles
summary: President Samia Suluhu Hassan urged East African Community members to strengthen vehicle manufacturing and assembly to reduce imports of second-hand vehicles. She spoke at the launch of the Double Q Automotive Assembly Plant in Entebbe, Uganda.
why: Local vehicle assembly can cut import dependence and create industrial jobs. It affects trade balances and the investment case for regional manufacturers.
